title: Plant Manager
text:
Plant Manager

**Company:** Smitty Bee Honey - Defiance, IA

**Reports to:** President

Job Summary

SBH is seeking an experienced, results-driven Plant Manager to coordinate and direct all major plant functions. You will oversee manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations while fostering positive employee relations and managing operational budgets. The ideal candidate will ensure strict compliance with SBH policies, food safety regulations, and legal requirements, while driving continuous improvement and on-time customer delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* **Operations & Production Management:** Oversee daily manufacturing, maintenance, and warehouse operations, ensuring production schedules and product quality consistently meet specifications.
* **Customer Fulfillment:** Coordinate and communicate scheduled open orders to guarantee on-time delivery to all SBH customers, supporting strategic efforts to retain existing business and generate new sales.
* **Continuous Improvement & Efficiency:** Identify and implement initiatives to reduce labor costs, material waste, and indirect expenses. Develop and manage labor utilization strategies that adapt effectively to shifting production demands and deadlines.
* **Equipment & Facility Optimization:** Partner with Engineering and Maintenance to minimize equipment downtime. Manage process flows, optimize plant layouts, and coordinate shutdowns and startups for new production lines and equipment installations.
* **Food Safety & Quality Culture:** Champion a strong food safety culture by ensuring strict site-wide adherence to Food Safety, Quality, HACCP, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
* **Workplace Safety:** Actively monitor, support, and enforce all plant safety objectives and regulatory standards.
* **Financial & Budgetary Oversight:** Consult with the SBH President on operational budgetary planning, forecasting, and disciplined spending.
* **Team Leadership & HR Partnership:** Collaborate with Human Resources on policy development, employee relations, talent development, and workforce motivation. Clearly communicate changes in company policies, procedures, and strategies to management and plant personnel.

Qualifications

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Business, Engineering, or Supply Chain Management preferred (equivalent relevant work experience will be considered).
* Experience:
* 5+ years of leadership experience within a manufacturing environment required.
* Prior food processing plant management experience in an HACCP- and GMP-regulated environment.
* Certifications & Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of HACCP, GMPs, and chain-of-custody management; current forklift certification (or willingness to obtain certification upon hire).
* Skills: Proven ability to communicate clearly, lead effectively, and influence team members across all levels of the organization.

Physical Requirements

* Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk, hear, bend, stoop, and kneel; occasionally required to climb, balance, crouch, and crawl.
* Frequently required to push, pull, lift, and carry up to 60 pounds with assistance.
* Routinely required to reach with hands and arms, involving repetitive motion of the wrists, hands, and fingers.
* Occasionally required to maintain balance while ascending or descending ladders or open stairs.
* Specific vision abilities required include close, distance, color, and peripheral vision, as well as depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

* Active, fast-paced manufacturing and production floor with heavy forklift traffic and moving machinery; constant situational awareness is essential.
* Exposure to varying climate conditions, including wet surfaces, temperature extremes (hot, unconditioned environments), and high noise levels.
* Strict adherence to food safety and PPE protocols is mandatory, including wearing hairnets/beard nets and following rigorous hand-washing procedures (safety training is provided).

Pay: $90,000.00 - $113,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person
